title: Who owns an integration connection and its credentials
question: Does a connection to Procore, Autodesk or Fieldwire belong to a user, a project or a company? What happens when the connecting user leaves, and how are the stored keys and tokens protected and shown?
context: Procore and Autodesk connect per user and Fieldwire per project (INTG-REQ-005). Automatic design updates depend on the importing user's Procore access.
